title: SWF compile: GroupObject on timeline silently dropped
description: GroupObject on timeline is now handled via flattenDisplayObjects() helper in compile.ts. The helper recursively expands groups into their children with accumulated x/y offsets. Applied at all frame.displayObjects iteration sites: video scan, font pre-pass, character pre-pass, depth pre-pass, frame loop pass 1, and mask clipDepth computation. Changes are in commit d93576c (landed as part of 0957 stash merge). All tests pass (1225 pass, 1 pre-existing failure in magnet-charids).
